intro: In Westfall, a weathered parchment carries the trail of notorious pirate Captain Sanders. It marks the second step in a treasure hunt across the bluffs and coastlines.

p: After you follow Captain Sanders' first treasure map, you find a parchment that points farther inland into Westfall. The scrawled note sends you east from the coast, up the bluffs toward the main road. Near crumbling stone ruins and an abandoned chimney, an old barrel marks the next place Sanders hid a clue, drawing seekers deeper into the troubled farmlands.
